beats.hindi_tts: और इसका टिक साइज याद रखिए: 1 बेसिस प्वाइंट यानी 0.01 परसेंट के उतार-चढ़ाव पर हर कॉन्ट्रैक्ट में ठीक 25 डॉलर का नकद नफा या नुकसान होता है!
beats.en_subtitle: Tick value invariant: Every 1 basis point (0.01%) move equals exactly $25 cash per contract!
beats.en_narration: Memorize this critical invariant: every 1 basis point or 0.01% interest rate move generates exactly $25 cash profit or loss per contract!

beats.hindi_tts: क्या फ्यूचर्स रेट और फॉरवर्ड रेट हमेशा एक समान होते हैं? बिल्कुल नहीं! डेली मार्क-टू-मार्केट सेटलमेंट के कारण फ्यूचर्स रेट हमेशा फॉरवर्ड रेट से अधिक होते हैं।
beats.en_subtitle: Are futures and forward rates identical? No! Daily settlement makes futures rates higher than forward rates.
beats.en_narration: Are futures rates and forward rates always identical? Absolutely not! Daily mark-to-market settlement causes futures rates to be systematically higher than forward rates.

steps.description: Futures generate daily cash flow positively correlated with interest rates.
For long maturities (T1 > 2 years), futures rates significantly exceed forward rates.
Subtract 0.5 * sigma^2 * T1 * T2 to obtain the true forward borrowing rate.

beats.hindi_tts: इस अंतर को कॉन्वेक्सिटी एडजस्टमेंट कहते हैं: फॉरवर्ड रेट बराबर फ्यूचर्स रेट माइनस आधा सिग्मा स्क्वायर गुणा टी वन गुणा टी टू। जहां सिग्मा ब्याज दरों की अस्थिरता है।
beats.en_subtitle: Convexity Adjustment: Forward Rate = Futures Rate - 0.5 * sigma^2 * T1 * T2.
beats.en_narration: This difference is the convexity adjustment: Forward Rate equals Futures Rate minus one-half sigma squared times T1 times T2, where sigma is annual interest rate volatility.

steps.description: Futures generate daily cash flow positively correlated with interest rates.

beats.en_subtitle: Example: At T1=5.0 and sigma=1.2%, the convexity adjustment is ~19 bps, critical for long-term pricing!
beats.en_narration: For example, with a five-year maturity and 1.2% volatility, the convexity adjustment is approximately 19 basis points—a massive discrepancy in long-term debt pricing!

beats.hindi_tts: बॉन्ड की वास्तविक मैच्योरिटी सिर्फ उसके आखिरी साल से तय नहीं होती। मैकाले ड्यूरेशन यह मापता है कि बॉन्ड के सभी कैश फ्लोज़ औसतन कितने समय बाद वापस मिलेंगे।
beats.en_subtitle: Macaulay duration measures the weighted average time until all discounted cash flows are received.
beats.en_narration: A bond's true maturity is not just its final redemption date. Macaulay duration measures the weighted-average time until all discounted coupon and principal cash flows are received.

steps.description: Each coupon C_i is discounted back to present value using e^(-y * t_i).
Each discounted payment is weighted by payment time t_i.
Dividing by current cash bond price B yields duration D in years.

semantics.teachingObjective: Introduce Macaulay duration formula and cash flow weighting

beats.hindi_tts: फार्मूला देखिए: हर कैश फ्लो सी आई को समय टी आई से गुणा करके वर्तमान मूल्य पर डिस्काउंट किया जाता है और कुल बॉन्ड भाव बी से भाग दिया जाता है।
beats.en_subtitle: Formula: Sum of time-weighted discounted cash flows divided by current market bond price B.
beats.en_narration: Observe the formula: each cash flow payment is multiplied by time t_i, discounted to present value, and normalized by dividing by the total market bond price B.

steps.description: Each coupon C_i is discounted back to present value using e^(-y * t_i).

beats.hindi_tts: जीरो-कूपन बॉन्ड की मैकाले ड्यूरेशन उसकी मैच्योरिटी के बिल्कुल बराबर होती है। लेकिन कूपन बॉन्ड की ड्यूरेशन कूपन पेमेंट्स के कारण हमेशा मैच्योरिटी से कम होती है!
beats.en_subtitle: Zero-coupon bond duration equals maturity; coupon bond duration is always shorter than maturity!
beats.en_narration: A zero-coupon bond's duration exactly equals its maturity. However, coupon payments pull cash flows earlier, so coupon bond duration is always shorter than its maturity!

steps.description: Each coupon C_i is discounted back to present value using e^(-y * t_i).

The Convexity Wedge: Daily mark-to-market settlement makes futures rates systematically higher than forward rates.
Convexity Adjustment Formula: Forward Rate = Futures Rate - 0.5 * sigma^2 * T1 * T2 reduces long-dated futures rates.
Macaulay Duration: Measures effective cash flow timing as the weighted average maturity of discounted payments.
Modified Duration Sensitivity: Linear price loss is given by Delta B / B approx -D* * Delta y for small parallel shifts.

Bank ALM Duration Gap: Banks holding long assets and short liabilities face balance sheet wipeout when yields surge.
Target Immunization Rule: Shorting N* = (P * D_P) / (V_F * D_F) contracts immunizes portfolios against parallel yield shifts.
ui_state.bottomTakeaway: Interest rate futures and duration immunization are the primary tools protecting global financial institutions from yield curve shocks.
